articles.author: Robert Folker
articles.title: Flydubai 'hijacker' who stabbed co-pilot 'planned to crash aircraft into Ben Gurion airport', UAE claims
articles.description: The hijacker attempted to take control of the plane 'with the intention of causing the greatest possible number of human casualties,' the UAE's top prosecutor said
articles.content:
The co-pilot who attempted to hijack an Israel-bound flight planned to crash it into a terminal at Israel's Ben Gurion Airport in a 9/11-inspired attack, according to the UAE attorney general.
